channel.title: Via Fidelitatis — Faithful FI for Catholic Families
channel.description: Practical financial independence tools and faith-filled stewardship insights for Catholic families. FI calculator, college planning, and generational wealth rooted in fidelity.

item.title: Build Margin Through Gospel Poverty: Lessons from St. Dominic
item.description: On the Memorial of St. Dominic, Catholic families learn that embracing Gospel poverty — owning less and clinging less — creates the practical margin that turns financial independence into everyday freedom and joy.

item.title: How to Get Started on Your FI Path
item.description: A simple, faith-aligned starting point for Catholic families: name the goal, get honest numbers, run the calculator once, and pick one lever this month.

item.title: Why FI for Catholics
item.description: Financial independence for Catholic families means margin for vocation — Providence and prudence together, tithing in the plan, honest math for large households.

item.title: Triple Savings on Online Purchases
item.description: Stack credit-card rewards, cashback portals, and checkout offers so everyday shopping funds the FI path without debt.

item.title: Build Margin to Trust Providence: Lessons from St. Cajetan
item.description: On the Memorial of St. Cajetan, Catholic families learn that real financial margin is the practical foundation that lets trust in Providence replace anxiety.

item.title: See the Glory Ahead: Lessons from the Transfiguration
item.description: The Transfiguration reminds families that a clear vision of the end — including faithful FI — sustains the hard work of the present.

item.title: Why FI for Everyone
item.description: Financial independence isn’t just for tech bros or high earners — it’s for regular families ready to build margin, faith, and freedom.
